card.head: Mera: One Passkey, Many Keys · Thenar

scenes.title: One passkey: identity
lines: One passkey, made through Mera. Its P-256 key goes into PasskeyRegistry, and Monad's precompile verifies every signature, so each paid run comes from a person.

scenes.title: Many keys: the arm's key from the PRF
lines: Then the non-account part. Mera evaluates the passkey's PRF with a purpose salt, thenar so101 commands, and HKDF turns it into an Ed25519 key, held in a Mera signing session. Nothing is stored. Derive it again, and it's the same key; a different purpose gives an independent one.

scenes.title: The key the robot obeys
notes: WEBXR · EMULATED HEADSET (IWER) · LIVE MONAD TESTNET
lines: That key signs the commands to the operator's own arm, and the arm relay obeys only its owner.

card.head: Who you are. What your robot obeys.

lines: No seed phrase, no key file: one passkey, many keys.
